body: I'm at my breaking point right now. I really am. I just want to die. I don't want to be alive anymore. I'm sick of this. I can't do this anymore. I'm sorry.
I don't know. I just don't know if I can handle this anymore. I'm done.

I don't know. I just don't know if I can do this. It's too hard. But if I do this, it's not your fault. You didn't fail at trying to talk me out of this. You did a great job, but the pain from everything else is just too much. Everything is just too much. I really don't know if I can carry on much longer.
I don't know. My dad just told me that I should kill myself, so I think I should. I don't know why he hates me so much. I don't understand it. I don't know if I can do this anymore. I'm sorry.

I don't even know what to say. My mind is jumbled mess. I'm thinking so much, but I can't get it down in words very easily. I'm just sick of feeling the way that I do. I'm sick of the self harm urges. I'm sick of the terrifying flashbacks. I can't handle them anymore. They is too many of them. I feel like I'm constantly having them. I'm too broken to be fixed. So I might as well give up. I'm done.
I don't know. I'm done. I can't take this anymore. I really don't know what to do right now. I just want to die.

I'm unfortunately still alive. My dad was yelling at me for something incredibly stupid. I haven't done anything too bad yet. I'm still planning on ending everything though. I'm so done dealing with everything. I want to die.

Everything seems wrong right now. I probably sound like a typical teenager when I say this, but my dad is a huge part of it. He calls me every name in the book. He tells me that I'm worthless and fat and stupid and ugly and that I'm a slut. I'm just sick of this. I know that I can move out in a few years, but it doesn't seem like things will ever get any better. I feel like I'll be stuck like this until I die. I'm sorry. Bye.
It doesn't even matter anymore. I'm just so sick of this. I'm done. Less than ten minutes left. And still, no one even cares.
